conclusions.existing_direct_scc_start_route: Not proven. Existing profile maps SCC for dynamic discovery. Prioritization applies to all AI agents rather than selecting SCC.
conclusions.direct_start_candidate: A new actual Virtual Agent topic with AI Connector selecting SCC, assigned as custom greeting or invoked via BotAPI SWITCH topic.id. Not created or tested; interactive SCC behavior needs validation.
conclusions.topic_id_constraint: Official Bot API topic.id refers to sys_cs_topic; do not substitute sn_aia_agent ID.
conclusions.processing_message: Official docs permit configuring/disabling processing and completion messages, but do not identify BotAPI control type. No source links sn_aia_agent.processing_message to the observed English initial OutputText.
conclusions.dynamic_loader: Official patch notes explicitly place agent processing steps/status updates in DynamicLoaderRichControl. This does not prove exclusive mapping of processing_message to DynamicLoader.
conclusions.persona: Identity/expertise/tone/length fields exist. No inspected source proves persona_description controls orchestrator preliminary OutputText language. No persona change recommended as a proven fix.

source_documents.supports: SWITCH/topic.id uses actual Virtual Agent sys_cs_topic.
Agent prioritization applies to all AI agents during discovery.
VA topic AI Connector can select an AI agent and Task mapping.
Custom greeting topic is supported; promoted assets are separate suggested launches.
Persona means nickname/subject matter with tone and response-length choices; no documented orchestrator-prelude language guarantee.
Agent processing/completion messages can be configured and toggled. No BotAPI wire-control mapping supplied.
PRB1877432 processing steps within dynamic loading control; PRB1878226 progressMessages in DynamicLoaderRichControl.

repository_findings.finding: Bot integration payload had no agentId/skillId/topicId at read; optional requester_session_language/history/nowSessionId/action.
Preferred skill capture count0; no captured preferred-skill implementation semantics.
DynamicLoader is classified separately from ordinary streaming. No processing_message/persona_description source mapping found.

limitations: Read-only inspection cannot establish whether a proposed configuration changes observed runtime prelude.
One Agentic support click timed out; state read showed no change. Later semantic click succeeded. No input values changed.
Current native personalization preview is illustrative; it is not an execution test.
General greeting readiness/provider-contract issue remains unresolved.
